role: Redstone ore (73) and its lit form (74): touching, walking on or using it lights it with reddust particle draws, a random tick puts it back, and it drops 4-5 redstone plus fortune and xp.

members.name: field_150187_a
members.note: lit flag: row 74 has light 9 and tick_randomly

members.name: func_149738_a
members.note: tick rate 30; the ore never schedules a tick itself

members.name: onBlockClicked
members.note: six rows of three world-Random floats, then 73 -> 74

members.name: onEntityWalking
members.note: mobs through living.c, the player through survival.c sp_walking_block for both ore blocks (the lit one draws and does not write); a snapshot-loaded server player steps (player.c server_player_load: canTriggerWalking, nextStepDistance and distanceWalkedOnStepModified from player_server.nbt); world Random draws. The client world's mob copies step too (clientworld.c client_walking_block: their step counters kept per copy, restored from clientents; the sparkle on WorldClient.rand and the local light-up, pfc-orewalk-g12)

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: the redstone-ore case: 18 world-Random floats, 73 -> 74, answers false so a held block still places (ore-use-s1)

members.name: func_150185_e
members.note: particle draws then the light-up write, inlined in each caller (dig.c, activate.c, survival.c, living.c)

members.name: randomDisplayTick

members.name: func_150186_m
members.note: the particles and every draw, checked per tick against the spawn log in fx_rain

notes: The glow and the draws are not redstone power, so the ore stays in scope under redstone = off. ore-use-s1 right-clicks it with and without a block in hand, walks over unlit and lit ore and mines it. The client world's own func_150185_e (its World.rand draws and its local light-up on click, use and walk) is not modelled; no row field covers it. lane/idxblocks: every member is exact for the server. The client world's own func_150185_e (its World.rand floats and local light-up) is n/a here: the whole-server replay and the playable client keep no WorldClient.rand stream (only test_clientworld does, over walks), the local light-up is overwritten by the server's S23 of the same block, and the particles construct nothing under the pinned minimal setting. Follow-up for the client-world lane.
